prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A flat app-icon glyph — a simple open circle with a centered dot, the
universal "mark, notice" sigil. Neutral dark flat fill.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon vector glyph centered on an off-white (#E7E3D5) canvas with generous padding. A bold open circle ring with a centered dot inside — the universal notice or bullet sigil. Both shapes rendered as crisp flat fills in deep near-black (#0B0F14), sharp vector edges, no gradients, no texture, no brushwork. Circle stroke weight bold enough to read at 16px. Minimalist single-subject composition, clean modern UI icon register matching Phosphor Fill or SF Symbols Filled style. No background detail, no scene, no ornamentation.
